The Petitioner submitted that the delay was bona fide, non-deliberate, and occurred solely because the Petitioner, in its capacity as a Renewable Energy Implementing Agency (REIA), was tying up power with prospective Buying Entities/Distribution Licensees before filing. Accordingly, the Commission has considered the Petitioner’s submission and directed the Petitioner to strictly adhere to the timelines specified in the Guidelines in future cases. 26. Accordingly, under Section 63 of the Act, the Commission adopts the individual tariffs for the Renewable Power Developers, as discovered and agreed to by the successful bidder(s), subject to the Petitioner tying up the capacity under the PPAs and PSAs.
